screening_disagreements_flagged_for_huma: PMC9636423 (Grange 2022, SLF2/SMC5 'mosaic variegated hyperploidy') was EXCLUDED as 'Atelís syndrome, not MVA' while PMC12691382 (SMC5, near-tetraploidy/MVA) was INCLUDED. The same gene family screened both ways. Needs a human ruling on whether hyperploidy/tetraploidy phenotypes are inside Stratum B.
PMC3613689 (Ricke & van Deursen 2013) was INCLUDED but is a narrative review; protocol eligibility excludes reviews as evidence sources. Should be demoted to reference-mining seed.

PMC8769543 (biallelic BUB1) was EXCLUDED as 'BUB1 not BUB1B'. Correct under Stratum A, but it is a legitimate Stratum B comparator (SAC-gene neurodevelopmental syndrome). Under the user's 'BUB1B deep, others summary' ruling it stays out of deep extraction but should be cited in the comparator summary.

bio_431175dc (Gama Braga - BUBR1 pseudokinase domain) and bio_44cf6e1f (Zhang - BubR1 TPR domain) were EXCLUDED by the dosage screen. Correct for the dosage axis, but both are load-bearing for the DOMAIN MAP and mechanism sections and are retained as mechanism sources outside the dosage extraction.
